title: Color-Burn
description: Minigame game about filling bottles featuring physics and offline capabilities.

title: Link IE
description: Handmade redirection manager behind IsenEngineering's (student association) proxy featuring SSO.

title: Kernel-Panic
description: An 'Escape Game' hackathon where participants must solve challenges & puzzles. They all have the same environment and compete with a real-time leaderboard.

title: La Bourse Folle
description: A stock exchange-style app where drink prices dynamically adjust based on consumption during IsenEngineering association events, featuring SSO for staff and real-time updates.

title: Neon-Dawn
description: A hackathon where participants use code to launch and control a satellite into orbit.

title: All Game Long - Bet
description: An app to bet fictional money during a student competitive event with a scoreboard. Who will have the most money at the end of the night?

title: Tidee
description: A platform to track attendance and manage members of the IsenEngineering association.
